description: This file defines an abstract class AddOnImpl that implements the AddOn interface, representing an add-on component within the AnySoftKeyboard project. It manages add-on metadata, resource mapping, and context handling.

classes.name: AddOnImpl
classes.description: An abstract class implementing the AddOn interface, managing add-on metadata, resource mapping, and context handling within the keyboard application.

classes.name: AddOnResourceMappingLocalImpl
classes.description: A local implementation of AddOnResourceMapping for add-ons within the same package, providing direct resource ID mappings.

classes.name: AddOnResourceMappingImpl
classes.description: A remote resource mapping implementation that handles resource ID translation between local and remote add-ons, utilizing weak references and caching.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the add-on.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Returns the description of the add-on.

methods.name: getPackageName
methods.description: Returns the package name of the add-on.

methods.name: getApiVersion
methods.description: Returns the API version supported by the add-on.

methods.name: getPackageContext
methods.description: Retrieves the package context, creating it if necessary, with error handling.

methods.name: getSortIndex
methods.description: Returns the sort index for ordering add-ons.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the add-on.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Provides a hash code based on the add-on ID.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality based on add-on ID and API version.

methods.name: getResourceMapping
methods.description: Returns the resource mapping object associated with the add-on.

methods.name: setNewConfiguration
methods.description: Updates the context with a new configuration and clears cached package context.

methods.name: isHiddenAddon
methods.description: Indicates whether the add-on is hidden.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the add-on.
